programmes.d: Things are not as they seem in a case involving gang violence and social profiling. Rusty is apprehensive to meet Kris's (MADISON McLAUGHLIN) parents. TOM BERENGER guest stars.
It's a media frenzy when a body is found at the home of an award-winning swimming coach. Kris's (MADISON McLAUGHLIN) mother pays Raydor a visit to discuss some concerns.
DDA Hobbs (KATHE MAZUR) gets involved in a case concerning the suspicious death of a customs agent. Provenza avoids discussing a sensitive issue with Raydor. Guest stars abound.
The NCIS team investigates when an honored Marine veteran falls to his death at a hotel.
After McGee's sister appears at his door bloodied and confused, he struggles to piece together her whereabouts the night before.
The NCIS team begrudgingly joins forces with the FBI when they identify the remains of a man on a Marine base as a serial killer the FBI has been hunting for 12 years.
When a highly classified robotic vehicle called "Otto" causes the death of a Navy Lieutenant, Gibbs and the team initially think the cause of death is suicide.
Gibbs and the team rush to a scene where a high-level intelligence officer was murdered, only to discover that the crime took place three days earlier and was "investigated" by the local authorities.

After 10 kilograms of highly toxic chemical weapons go missing, Gibbs and his team scramble to locate it. The NCIS team is horrified when they discover that the deadly chemical weapon is now held by wanted terrorist Mamoun Sharif.

After capturing one international arms dealer, the NCIS team discovers that the Navy's highly classified weapons system is about to be sold to another high priority arms dealer known as "La Grenouille" (Armand Assante).
Working with the local officials, the NCIS team originally believes a the sailor died of an unintentional drug overdose in a seedy part of town.

Gibbs and the team collaborate with an inspector for the International Atomic Energy Agency suffering from radiation poisoning, recreating his routine in an effort to figure out when the contamination took place.

When Ducky and Abby confirm that they have identified the remains of at least five people, the NCIS team immediately begins notifying the families in the hopes of making some connection between the seemingly random selection of victims.
The NCIS team investigates when a marine thought to have frozen to death wakes up on Ducky's autopsy table.

Gibbs and the team investigate when a weekend call to an NCIS tip line results in the death of two agents. The NCIS team discovers a tip about terrorist activity was a trap that resulted in the death of two agents.
In a case that hits a little too close to home for Rusty, a 19-year-old prostitute is brutally murdered.

After a bad batch of drugs claims the lives of two brothers in high school, the race is on to find the dealer. Rusty feels smothered by his new around-the-clock security detail.
The squad tries to find a newly released prisoner who has missed two parole meetings. Therapist Dr. Joe Bowman (BILL BROCHTRUP) evaluates Rusty over a game of chess.
When a body turns up at a posh country club, the squad's investigation leads them down a money trail full of surprises. DDA Rios' actions have Rusty questioning her intentions.
Christmas vacation is interrupted when a baseball scout is found dead, and a complicated kidnapping scheme unfolds. Rusty opens up to Dr. Joe (BILL BROCHTRUP) about his mom.
Major Crimes works with the FBI, including Fritz Howard (JON TENNEY), on a case. It is revealed how each member of the unit became interested in joining the police force.
The squad investigates a bomb explosion. Rusty dons a bulletproof vest in an attempt to catch the person responsible for threatening him. MALCOLM-JAMAL WARNER guest stars.
The squad must work quickly to track down a serial killer before he strikes again. Things get dangerous over a game of chess. MALCOLM-JAMAL WARNER appears as Lt. Chuck Cooper.
Season finale: The squad draws closer to finding a dangerous serial killer. Rusty faces his biggest challenge as he takes the stand against Stroh. JERI RYAN, JON TENNEY guest star.
